title: Emery picked 'best players to be here with Villa' amid Garnacho snub
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutEmery picked 'best players to be here with Villa' amid Garnacho snubShareThere was a notable absentee on Aston Villa's bench in the Champions League against Galatasaray, with Alejandro Garnacho left out.Unai Emery claimed Alejandro Garnacho was excluded from Aston Villa's Champions League squad against Galatasaray due to picking the "best players to be here with us".
Villa were below par against Galatasaray, falling to a 1-0 defeat at RAMS Park through substitute Deniz Gul's 77th-minute header.
And Garnacho failed to make the travelling party to Istanbul, despite Emery naming two back-up goalkeepers and opting to fill only 11 of the 12 available options on the bench.

The Argentine is on a season-long loan from Chelsea, with his deal including an obligation to buy if certain conditions were met, but he has made just seven appearances in all competitions, with none of those coming from the start.
Garnacho has also failed to make the previous two Premier League squads – both games Villa drew – and Emery seemingly confirmed the winger was not in his immediate plans.
"The players who were here are who I think are the best players to be here with us," said Emery.
Villa have lost successive games in major European competition for the first time since a run of three in April/May 2024 in the Conference League.
It is also the first time since November 2024 that they have failed to score in successive outings in major European competitions.

Indeed, Villa failed to record a shot on target in a game for the third time in all competitions this season; prior to this campaign, they had recorded at least one in all previous 196 games under Emery.
The Spaniard was frustrated, claiming the surface also hindered his team.
"Disappointed a little bit," Emery said. "After their goal, it was impossible to play.
"They wasted time. They added only five minutes. OK. Finish the match. We don't want to play more. I don't think the referee was fair there. It is like that.
"Two years ago, we lost to [Club] Brugge and Monaco away. I can compare this match like those matches.
"Why? Because their supporters are pushing so much. The pitch was not helping. The match was difficult because they pressed intense.
"We did a fantastic job in the first half. We stopped them from keeping the ball and going long. We avoided transitions. It was not enough because we lacked offensively."
